name: oxly
displayName: Oxly — Chrome DevTools for AI Agents
description: Trace, cost, and security observability for AI agents. Phase 0 scaffold: plugin shell + live /mcp endpoint.

mcp.note: Empty tool list in Phase 0. Inspector must get init ok.

ui.note: Production UI assets MUST be hosted at the stable HTTPS origin allow-listed by the API Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors/script-src). Local dev serves packages/plugin/ui/ at /plugin/ui/.

auth.note: Phase 0 allows unauthenticated initialize for MCP Inspector. Phase 1 enforces project-scoped auth via get_user_project_ids / verify_project_ownership.
